description: Populate with independent, sourced endpoint-to-endpoint straight-line measurements. Do not insert ADS-B flown mileage, route duration, flight-track length, or distances calculated from a spherical/ellipsoidal formula.

measurementPolicy.splitPolicy: Assign complete unordered endpoint pairs to either train or holdout before fitting. Never place the same pair in both splits.
measurementPolicy.sourcePolicy: Record the original survey, instrument, dataset row, or other traceable reference for every distance.
